provision.cloudInit:
#cloud-config
hostname: gpu-7
write_files:
  - path: /etc/bcd/join-token
    permissions: '0600'
    content: bcjt_01k5w0000000000000000000000.contract
  - path: /etc/systemd/system/bcd.service
    permissions: '0644'
    content: |
      [Unit]
      Description=better-compute node agent
      After=network-online.target bcd-join.service
      Wants=network-online.target
      [Service]
      ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/bcd node
      Restart=always
      RestartSec=5
      [Install]
      WantedBy=multi-user.target
runcmd:
  - [sh, -c, "curl -fsSL 'https://compute.example.com/api/compute/downloads/bcd/0.5.0/linux-amd64' -o /usr/local/bin/bcd && echo 'abababababababababababababababababababababababababababababababab  /usr/local/bin/bcd' | sha256sum -c - && chmod 0755 /usr/local/bin/bcd"]
  - [/usr/local/bin/bcd, join, --server, https://compute.example.com/api/compute, --token-file, /etc/bcd/join-token, --node-id, node_01k5w00000000000000000inst]
  - [systemctl, enable, --now, bcd.service]

robot.script:
set -eu
umask 077
test -s /root/bc-join-token
DRIVES=$(lsblk -dn -o NAME,TYPE | awk '$2=="disk" && $1 ~ /^nvme/ {print "/dev/"$1}')
[ -n "$DRIVES" ] || DRIVES=$(lsblk -dn -o NAME,TYPE | awk '$2=="disk" && $1 ~ /^sd/ {print "/dev/"$1}')
N=0; : > /root/bc-autosetup
for D in $DRIVES; do N=$((N+1)); echo "DRIVE$N $D" >> /root/bc-autosetup; done
if [ "$N" -gt 1 ]; then echo "SWRAID 1" >> /root/bc-autosetup; echo "SWRAIDLEVEL 1" >> /root/bc-autosetup; else echo "SWRAID 0" >> /root/bc-autosetup; fi
cat >> /root/bc-autosetup <<'EOF'
HOSTNAME gpu-7
PART /boot/efi esp 256M
PART /boot ext3 1024M
PART / ext4 all
IMAGE /root/.oldroot/nfs/install/../images/Ubuntu-2404-noble-amd64-base.tar.gz
EOF
printf '#!/bin/sh\nset -eu\numask 077\nmkdir -p /etc/bcd\necho %s | base64 -d > /etc/bcd/join-token\nchmod 0600 /etc/bcd/join-token\n' "$(base64 -w0 /root/bc-join-token)" > /root/bc-post-install.sh
cat >> /root/bc-post-install.sh <<'EOF'
curl -fsSL --retry 5 -o /usr/local/bin/bcd 'https://compute.example.com/api/compute/downloads/bcd/0.5.0/linux-amd64'
echo 'abababababababababababababababababababababababababababababababab  /usr/local/bin/bcd' | sha256sum -c -
chmod 0755 /usr/local/bin/bcd
cat > /etc/systemd/system/bcd-join.service <<'UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=Join better-compute
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target
ConditionPathExists=/etc/bcd/join-token
[Service]
Type=oneshot
RemainAfterExit=yes
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/bcd join --server https://compute.example.com/api/compute --token-file /etc/bcd/join-token --attestor provisioned --serving-ca-pin sha256/AQEBAQEBAQEBAQEBAQEBAQEBAQEBAQEBAQEBAQEBAQE= --join-signing-pin sha256/AgICAgICAgICAgICAgICAgICAgICAgICAgICAgICAgI= --join-encryption-pin sha256/AwMDAwMDAwMDAwMDAwMDAwMDAwMDAwMDAwMDAwMDAwM=
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=15
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
UNIT
cat > /etc/systemd/system/bcd.service <<'UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=better-compute node agent
After=network-online.target bcd-join.service
Wants=network-online.target
[Service]
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/bcd node
Restart=always
RestartSec=5
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
UNIT
systemctl enable bcd-join.service bcd.service
shred -u "$0" 2>/dev/null || rm -f "$0"
EOF
chmod 0700 /root/bc-post-install.sh
/root/.oldroot/nfs/install/installimage -a -c /root/bc-autosetup -x /root/bc-post-install.sh
shred -u /root/bc-join-token /root/bc-post-install.sh
reboot
